name: axi4_slave
description: AXI4 slave protocol contract — strict ordering variant. Captures the canonical AMBA AXI4 slave handshake: AWREADY → AWVALID acceptance; WLAST closes the data phase; BVALID rises after the last write beat. ILLUSTRATIVE: this entry demonstrates the corpus schema for Document D, it is not derived from any specific vendor's silicon.

alternatives.label: Strict ordering
alternatives.description: Responses are returned in the order requests were accepted.

alternatives.label: Out-of-order responses allowed
alternatives.description: BRESP may return out of order; the contract drops the strict-ordering guarantee.

provenance.verified_against: ARM AMBA AXI4 specification rev I (illustrative — no real vendor silicon was modelled)
